title: Beyond I’m Sorry, I Can’t: Dissecting Large-Language-Model Refusal
reasoning: The paper is a mechanistic interpretability study focusing on the internal causes of refusal behavior in LLMs using Sparse Autoencoders. Although the authors identify and label some latent features as 'Morality', the study's goal is to map the technical mechanisms of safety-refusal and jailbreaking, not to evaluate or benchmark moral, religious, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
